description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryDetailedModel class, which is a data model representing detailed employee information for a corporate directory API in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses traits for serialization and normalizes employee entity data into an API response structure with various attributes like employee number, name, job title, location, and contact info.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class representing detailed employee information for the corporate directory API in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for API serialization.
